title: deotte-plus-lgbm-m4
hypothesis: Adding a LightGBM model (num_leaves=63, lr=0.05, early-stop 100) on the m1 feature matrix as a 4th equal-weight member of the Deotte 3xXGB+freq blend lifts CV by >= 0.0001 via cross-library diversity
rationale: Queue item 1 (3-seed blend) is killed (+0.00002); item 2 (blend weights) has nothing to gain since m1/m2/m3 CV are 0.94317/0.94322/0.94311 vs blend 0.94333; item 3 (LGBM 4th model) was never scored - its only attempt was an executor timeout, not a CV kill. The three XGB variants are ~0.99 correlated, so a second tree library (leaf-wise growth, different binning) is the cheapest source of decorrelated error. Plan is kept to 2 files / 13 verbatim one-line find-replace edits / 1 smoke command because 3-file plans timed out the Qwen executor three times.
one_change: Add flag --lgbm to `train --strategy deotte`: when set, run_cv also trains DeotteVariant.LGBM ('m4') = LGBMClassifier(num_leaves=63, learning_rate=0.05, n_estimators=3000, subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.8, early stopping 100) on the m1 feature matrix; blend = equal mean over all trained variants (now 4). --freq kept; folds/seed/metric/XGB params/recipe unchanged.
code_instructions: Read outputs/NEXT_STRATEGY.md fully; every edit is a verbatim FIND -> REPLACE. notes_md:
# exp0002 — deotte-plus-lgbm-m4

**Parent:** exp0001 (CV 0.94333 ± 0.00070)

**Hypothesis:** Adding a LightGBM model (`m4`: num_leaves=63, lr=0.05, n_estimators=3000,
subsample=0.8/freq=1, colsample=0.8, early-stop 100) trained on the exact m1 feature matrix
(helpers + freq counts) as a 4th equal-weight member of the Deotte 3xXGB blend lifts CV by
>= 0.0001. The three XGB variants are ~0.99 correlated; a second tree library (leaf-wise
growth, different histogram binning) is the cheapest source of decorrelated error.

**Change:** new `--lgbm` flag on `train --strategy deotte`; `run_cv` trains `DeotteVariant.LGBM`
("m4") when set; blend = equal mean over all trained variants. `--freq` kept. Folds (5, seed 42),
metric, XGB params, recipe and base_margin unchanged. `predict_proba` reads the variant list
from `cv.json` so predict stays consistent with train.
